examShortTricks: Trick 1: First law one line: m = ZIt with Z = E/96500 (E = equivalent mass) — every numerical is a direct substitution.
Trick 2: Second law in ratio form: masses deposited by the same charge are in the ratio of equivalent masses, m1/m2 = E1/E2.
Trick 3: Charge bookkeeping: Q = It (I in amperes, t in seconds); moles of electrons = Q/96500; then divide by the ion charge.
Trick 4: 1 F deposits 1 equivalent = 1 mole of electrons' worth — Ag (108 g), Cu 63.5/2, Al 27/3.
